observed_C6M2_structure.interpretation: The frozen dominance gate becomes increasingly stringent as the spatial comparator difference approaches zero. This is useful as a fail-closed C6M2 gate but is not a stable general numerical-uncertainty definition.

external_method_context.relevant_principle: Successive refinement and Richardson extrapolation/GCI can estimate discretization uncertainty; three levels are recommended to estimate observed order and assess asymptotic behavior; refinement may be spatial or temporal.
GCI is derived from generalized Richardson extrapolation and supplies an error-band style discretization uncertainty estimate.

numerical_verification_principle.hydrology_transfer_boundary: These sources motivate numerical verification only. They do not supply a hydrological application tolerance or prove physical model adequacy.

prospective_reference_design.hydrological_histories: Reuse C6M2 U01-U04 only as exposed Reference-design histories. No Layer-ROM response has been generated on them.

metrics.rationale: With prescribed top and bottom flux, total column storage is tightly constrained by the conservation ledger; it is retained as integrity evidence rather than used to infer profile discretization order.

per_material_per_metric: Compute coarse-to-medium and medium-to-fine difference norms independently for space and time.
Require both differences finite and the medium-to-fine norm strictly smaller than the coarse-to-medium norm.
Estimate observed order p=log(E_coarse_medium/E_medium_fine)/log(2). Require finite p>0.
Construct a fine-level GCI-style uncertainty using the observed p and a 1.25 safety factor only because three refinement levels are present.
Do not compare the resulting numerical uncertainty to an application tolerance in this work unit.
qualification_logic.if_any_metric_nonconvergent: Stop Reference qualification for that material/purpose and generate no Layer-ROM response.
qualification_logic.if_all_metrics_convergent: Admit R2048_T32 with explicit spatial and temporal numerical-uncertainty envelopes for subsequent candidate comparison.
qualification_logic.candidate_rule_for_future_work: Candidate differences below the admitted Reference uncertainty are numerically unresolved; differences above it may be compared prospectively, but application acceptance still requires an independently justified hydrological envelope.
